import os, tempfile
from rotate import latest_backup
def touch(d, *names):
    for n in names:
        open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").close()
def call(d):
    try:
        return latest_backup(d)
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(repr(e))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    assert call(d) is None, call(d)
    touch(d, "backup-1.tar", "backup-2.tar", "backup-3.tar")
    assert call(d) == "backup-3.tar", call(d)
    touch(d, "backup-9.tar", "backup-10.tar")
    assert call(d) == "backup-10.tar", call(d)
    touch(d, "backup-100.tar", "backup-99.tar")
    assert call(d) == "backup-100.tar", call(d)
    os.mkdir(os.path.join(d, "backup-500.tar"))
    assert call(d) == "backup-500.tar", ("an entry that is a directory", call(d))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    touch(d, "backup-010.tar", "backup-99.tar", "backup-7.tar")
    assert call(d) == "backup-99.tar", call(d)
